description: Deploy the file 'acme_db_driver_v2.5.jar' located on the Desktop to the 'example-repo-local' repository. You must deploy it with the following custom Maven coordinates: Group ID: 'com.acme.db', Artifact ID: 'driver', Version: '2.5.0'. You must also enable the 'Generate Default POM' option so that a POM file is created automatically. Do not use the original filename; the artifact should be stored according to the Maven coordinates.
